overview.champions: Kaden Smith (2023), Chase Potter (2024), Sam Trusty (2025)

schedule.desc: Every manager plays their designated rival, once at each end of the season.
Every game is against your other two division-mates (each played twice across these four weeks).
Every game is against a manager outside your division (each played once).
See the playoff format for the bracket.

rules.playoffFormat: Seeds 1–3 are the three division winners, ranked 1–3 by regular season record. Seeds 4–6 are wildcards — the next-best regular season records league-wide. Seeds 1 & 2 get first-round byes. Round 1: 3 seed vs. 6 seed, 4 seed vs. 5 seed. The semifinals are reseeded rather than fixed: the 1 seed plays whichever Round 1 winner has the worse remaining seed, and the 2 seed plays whichever Round 1 winner has the better remaining seed. Losers of Round 1 play a 5th place game; losers of the Semifinals play a 3rd place game; Semifinal winners meet in the Championship.
rules.waivers: Standard waivers — not FAAB. Once a player is added or dropped, the waiver period is 1 day: other managers have 24 hours to submit a competing claim before it processes. Waiver priority resets every week to the inverse of the current standings — whoever has the worst record that week gets first priority, the best record picks last, and priority is fully re-sorted each week rather than rolling over. There's no season-long limit on acquisitions, and transactions are not locked for eliminated teams during the playoffs. ESPN's Undroppable Players List is observed, and the full NFL player pool is available.
rules.trades: No limit on the number of trades a manager can make. The trade deadline is December 2, 2026 at 9:00 AM PST. Every trade sits for a 1-day review period before processing, during which the league can vote to veto. 6 "veto" votes (from the 10 managers not involved) are required to overturn a trade; fewer than 6 and it processes as-is.
rules.draftOrder: Draft order is set in reverse order of the previous season's FINAL standing (including playoffs) — not regular season seed. The lower you finish, the earlier you pick. Example: if you finish 5th in the regular season but win the championship, your final standing is 1st, so you pick LAST (12th) in the next draft. The team that finishes last picks 1st.
rules.buyInDeadline: Buy-in must be paid in full before the draft date. Managers who haven't paid are not eligible to draft.
rules.gamblingRule: A bet needs 6 or more league members participating to be classified as an official "League Bet" and tracked in the running league total. Anything with fewer participants is logged as a personal or side bet — still on the record, just not counted toward the league-wide running total.
rules.keepers: This league is a full re-draft every season — no keepers. Confirmed off for both the 2026 and 2027 seasons.
